exposure: Placental histologic types (acute inflammation, maternal vascular malperfusion, fetal vascular malperfusion, chronic inflammation) from index spontaneous preterm birth
Progesterone receptor density in the decidua
outcome: Response to 17-hydroxyprogesterone caproate supplementation (prolonging gestation by >3 weeks beyond index gestational age at delivery or delivery at >=39 weeks' gestation)
cohort: The study included 352 women with singleton pregnancies who had an index spontaneous preterm birth and a subsequent birth within the same hospital system between 2009 and 2019, and for whom placental pathology from the index birth was available.
finding: No specific placental histologic type was independently associated with recurrent preterm birth, but low-grade acute inflammation was associated with a decreased likelihood of response to 17-hydroxyprogesterone caproate supplementation, while low-grade maternal vascular malperfusion was associated with a 4-fold increased likelihood of response among those with index deliveries <36 weeks' gestation.
gest_age: Babies from index spontaneous preterm births were included, with sensitivity analyses focusing on index births <36 weeks' gestation.
